findings.highlight: You were pretty badly wounded too
findings.evidenceJa: あんな酷い傷を負ったんだしさ
findings.governingReading: You took such a terrible wound
findings.explanation: “Too” implies that Shirou likewise suffered a comparable wound, although he is still minimizing his own condition as mere numbness.
Shirou’s dawning confirmation that he truly is tired becomes a confused question about what is happening.

findings.highlight: I think I can still get a good night’s sleep
findings.evidenceJa: 今夜は久しぶりに、ぐっすりと眠れそうだ
findings.governingReading: tonight, for the first time in a while, it seems I may sleep soundly
findings.explanation: The irony that this promises his first sound sleep in some time disappears, while unsupported “still” is added.

findings.governingReading: I claw frantically at the futon
findings.explanation: A violent scratching and tearing motion becomes a static squeeze, weakening the onset of Shirou’s agony.

findings.highlight: Every muscle, every bone in my body is messed up
findings.evidenceJa: 全身の筋肉、骨格という骨格が捩れている
findings.governingReading: Every muscle in my body, every last part of my skeleton, is twisting
findings.explanation: Exact internal torsion across muscle and skeleton becomes the vague colloquial “messed up.”

findings.highlight: My bones are twitching as if to complain to me
findings.evidenceJa: 手足の骨は宿主に抗議するようにささくれだち
findings.governingReading: The bones of my limbs splinter and bristle as though protesting against their host
findings.explanation: The invasive image of bones roughening or splintering against their “host” becomes ordinary twitching and direct complaint to Shirou.

findings.highlight: my ribs are shaking as if to burst out of my body
findings.evidenceJa: 肋骨あたりがギチギチと胸の肉を突き破ろうと蠢動している
findings.governingReading: around my ribs, something writhes and grinds as if trying to break through the flesh of my chest
findings.explanation: The ribs’ grinding, wormlike movement and the concrete chest flesh are reduced to shaking and the generic body.

findings.highlight: My whole body is pushed down by a great force
findings.evidenceJa: 巨大な万力で体ごと押し潰されている
findings.governingReading: my entire body is being crushed in a gigantic vise
findings.explanation: The enclosing mechanical image of a vise crushing his whole body becomes an unspecified downward force.

findings.highlight: I wiggle around like a bug
findings.evidenceJa: 蛆虫のように這い蹲って
findings.governingReading: crawling and huddling like a maggot
findings.explanation: A specifically abject maggot image and Shirou’s ground-hugging posture become a generic bug wiggling.
An external bodily sensation is reassigned to the brain, causing the next sentence’s separate sauna-brain image to be needlessly repeated.

findings.highlight: the abnormality Saber was talking about
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーが気遣っていた“身体の異状”なのか
findings.governingReading: the “bodily abnormality” Saber had been worried about
findings.explanation: Saber’s concern is presented as something she explicitly discussed, while the Japanese emphasizes the condition she had sensed and worried over.

findings.evidenceJa: 意識はぐつぐつと白ばんでいく
findings.governingReading: My consciousness bubbles and boils as it turns white
findings.explanation: The encroaching whiteness that marks Shirou’s loss of consciousness disappears from the image.
